features: Ultra-Clear 3MP HD Video Quality for Enhanced Home Security: Experience sharp, crystal-clear surveillance with the Godrej EVE Pro 3 Indoor Wi-Fi Camera featuring high-resolution 3MP HD video. The enhanced clarity ensures better identification of people and events, providing reliable and dependable security coverage for your home or office.

Ideal for continuous video recording, playback, and backup without relying on cloud subscriptions. Receive instant alerts on your phone whenever motion is detected, enhancing your home security system's efficiency. Perfect for intruder detection, activity monitoring, and ensuring the safety of your loved ones with smart surveillance technology.

Communicate instantly using the built-in 2-way talk feature, allowing real-time interaction with family members, visitors, or pets. Ideal for baby monitoring, elderly care, and smart communication, making your indoor security system more interactive and effective.
